gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: The journey was so tiring that we slept all day.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that we slept all day.
gaps.explanation: so tiring (a journey) → such a tiring journey.

gaps.lead: We wanted to continue our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.sentence: We ___ on with our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.hint: unfulfilled wish: would have liked to
gaps.explanation: An unrealised wish about the past: 'would have liked to carry on'.

gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.

gaps.lead: Brian was really interested in North American history in his school days.
gaps.sentence: Brian ___ North American history in his school days.
gaps.hint: be interested in = have an ___ in
gaps.explanation: 'To be interested in' becomes the noun pattern: 'had an interest in'.

gaps.lead: You can only get a seat if you book well in advance.
gaps.explanation: if you don't book = without booking.
